name: Einar Stonegrip
summary: Along the Wetlands crossroads, Einar Stonegrip keeps to the road and sends his goods to town with travelers. He avoids Menethil Harbor, where his estranged wife lives.

sections.title: A Trapper at the Crossroads
sections.body: Einar Stonegrip hunts crocolisks where the roads meet in the Wetlands. The crossroads link Dun Algaz, Dun Modr, and Menethil Harbor. He sells their sturdy hides to leatherworkers and merchants along the coast. Though rugged enough to wrestle reptiles from the mire, Einar is embroiled in a bitter falling-out with his wife, Sida. He stays on the road and asks travelers to carry his bundles of skins to his trading partner, James Halloran, rather than enter Menethil Harbor himself.

faq.answer: Einar Stonegrip hunts crocolisks at the Wetlands crossroads and sells their hides in Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why won't Einar deliver his own goods to Menethil Harbor?
aliases: why doesn't einar go to town
faq.answer: Einar avoids Menethil Harbor because he is on terribly bad terms with his wife, Sida, who lives there. He stays in the swamplands and pays passing couriers to carry his goods.

faq.q: Who does Einar work with in Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Einar gathers crocolisk skins for James Halloran, a merchant in Menethil Harbor who sells leather goods.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may recognize Einar's rugged self-reliance. His troubles with his wife keep him in the soggy marshes instead of a warm tavern.
As an Alliance traveler, you may pass Einar's roadside post on the way between Ironforge and Menethil Harbor. He offers courier work along the Alliance supply routes.
